# PR #3647: Patch: follow-up to #3531 from the after-merge spot-check

Closes #3637

## What changed and why

The spot-check found §15.8 and R3496000 contradicting themselves and the code: the ruling attributed the unfoldable run's 0 row / 0 score / 0 Embers to "§15.8's abandon rule", and §15.8 said an uncarried run "ends the same way" as abandoning — but an abandoned run is scored and paid Embers (§15.10, via `settle()`), while an unfoldable run is not (`settleUnfoldable()` hardcodes 0/0/0). No behavior change; the code was already right.

- [spec/15-dungeon-run.md](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill-2/_work/_temp/work/item-3637/spec/15-dungeon-run.md) §15.8: split the sentence. Abandoning ends a run lost, still scored and paid Embers under `[[§15.10]]`; a run whose version this build no longer carries, or whose log folds under no carried version, ends lost with no row, no score and no Embers because there is nothing to fold to score it (`[[R3496000]]`).
- [spec/rulings/R3496000.md](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill-2/_work/_temp/work/item-3637/spec/rulings/R3496000.md): the 0/0/0 settlement is now the ruling's own decision ("because nothing can be folded to score it"), keeping the `[[§15.8]]` link; the "abandon rule" attribution is gone.
- [apps/web/src/dungeon/store.test.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill-2/_work/_temp/work/item-3637/apps/web/src/dungeon/store.test.ts): `B20 abandon records a loss` now asserts `score: 120, embers: 12` (the fixture defaults), proving abandon pays; both R3496000 unfoldable tests keep their `score: 0, embers: 0` assertions and add `runScore`/`runEmbers` `not.toHaveBeenCalled()`, proving the unfoldable path never scores.

## How it was tested

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/dungeon/store.test.ts` — 34/34 passed (the run first rebuilt the WASM module, ~37 min on the shared machine).
- `cargo jackioh spec check` — ok: 1889 rulings, 4899 proofs, 61409 citations in 3988 files, 25110 links.
- `cargo fmt --check` — clean.
- `git status` shows exactly the three intended files; no new ruling note, no `spec/pending/3637.md`, nothing under `crates/` or `store.ts`.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

None of substance — the plan fixed every wording choice. One small style call: in R3496000 I kept the `[[§15.8]]` citation at the end of the reworded sentence (now reading "…to score it ([[§15.8]]), with the time played…") rather than dropping the link, since the plan required keeping it and the ruling still settles within §15.8's tiles context. Rejected alternative: touching `settleUnfoldable()` or `settle()` — the code already implements the correct distinction, so any behavior edit would have introduced the very bug the issue describes.

Reviewers should look twice at the reworded §15.8 sentence: it now covers both unfoldable cases (unversioned build *and* log folding under none), matching the ruling's first paragraph.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `muse`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 3 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

The after-merge spot-check of #3531 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42786771943)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`f811a74c33ff`). `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #3531 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `spec/rulings/R3496000.md:19`: The ruling says an unfoldable run settles lost under "§15.8's abandon rule: no row, no score, no Embers", and the new §15.8 sentence (spec/15-dungeon-run.md:230) says an uncarried run "ends the same way" as abandoning. But an abandoned run is scored and paid Embers, so the spec contradicts itself and the code.
  Evidence: §15.8 only says "Abandoning at any time ends a run, lost." §15.10 says Embers are run_embers of the score, paid when a run ends, and the score counts RUN_SCORE_ROW per row reached. In apps/web/src/dungeon/store.ts, abandonRun calls step(…, {type: "abandon"}), which calls settle(), which records rowReached from run.row, score = runScore(run, content) and embers = runEmbers(score), and adds those Embers to progress. settleUnfoldable (store.ts:333-372) records rowReached 0, score 0, embers 0 and EMPTY_RUN_STATS. So a reader of §15.8 would pay an uncarried run its Embers, which R3496000's code does not. Fix: reword §15.8:230 and R3496000.md:19 to say the unfoldable run ends lost with no row, score or Embers because nothing can be folded to score it. Present that as this ruling's own decision, not as §15.8's abandon rule.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

# Plan (muse-spark-1.3-contributor, medium)

## Goal

Fix the self-contradiction the spot-check found without touching behavior. The unfoldable run (version no longer carried, or log that folds under none) ends lost with row 0, score 0 and Embers 0 because there is nothing to fold and score, which is `R3496000`'s own decision; abandoning ends lost but is still scored and paid Embers under §15.10. Code already does this (`settle()` vs `settleUnfoldable()` in `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.ts`); only the two spec sentences and the tests locking the distinction change.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `spec/15-dungeon-run.md` | change | §15.8 sentence (~line 230): split abandon from unfoldable; unfoldable ends lost 0/0/0 for its own reason, linked to `[[R3496000]]` |
| `spec/rulings/R3496000.md` | change | Paragraph 2 (~lines 18-21): drop the "`[[§15.8]]`'s abandon rule" attribution; state 0/0/0 as this ruling's own "nothing can be folded to score it" decision |
| `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.test.ts` | change | Strengthen one abandon and two unfoldable tests to lock the distinction (see Steps) |
| Must not touch | — | `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` (forbidden); `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.ts` and all of `crates/` (no behavior change); `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/pending/3496.md` (no new ruling, no refold); do not create `spec/rulings/R3637*.md` or `spec/pending/3637.md`; never run `cargo jackioh spec index` |

Governing spec: §15.8 (abandon/tiles), §15.10 (score/Embers), ruling `R3496000`.

## Steps

1. Re-read `spec/15-dungeon-run.md` §§15.8 and 15.10, `spec/rulings/R3496000.md`, and `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.ts` functions `settle()` (~line 571) and `settleUnfoldable()` (~line 333) plus `abandonRun()` (~line 692). Confirm: `settle()` computes `runScore`/`runEmbers` and adds Embers; `settleUnfoldable()` hardcodes `rowReached: 0, score: 0, embers: 0` and never calls them. This confirms a spec-only fix.
2. In `spec/15-dungeon-run.md`, replace the §15.8 sentence at line 230 ("Abandoning at any time ends a run, lost. A run whose version this build no longer carries ends the same way (`[[R3496000]]`).") with two sentences: abandoning ends a run lost, still scored and paid Embers under `[[§15.10]]`; a run whose version this build no longer carries, or whose log folds under no carried version, ends lost with no row, no score and no Embers because there is nothing to fold to score it (`[[R3496000]]`). Keep both `[[...]]` links valid; keep the rest of the paragraph unchanged.
3. In `spec/rulings/R3496000.md`, replace the parenthetical in paragraph 2 ("It settles once as lost (`[[§15.8]]`'s abandon rule: no row, no score, no Embers)") with the ruling's own decision, e.g. "It settles once as lost with no row, no score and no Embers, because nothing can be folded to score it (`[[§15.8]]`)". Keep the `[[§15.8]]` and `[[R3502000]]` links and the `cards` front matter unchanged; change wording only.
4. In `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.test.ts`, strengthen the distinction (fixtures default `runScore` to 120, `runEmbers` to score/10, so a scoring path can never read 0/0 by accident):
   - In `it("B20 abandon records a loss and clears the run")`: after `abandon()`, assert the record holds the scored values (`score: 120, embers: 12`) alongside the existing `rowReached: 0` check, proving abandon pays.
   - In `it("R3496000 a kept run that will not fold settles once as lost and banks its extractions")` and `it("R3496000 a kept run whose version this build does not carry settles once as lost")`: keep the existing `score: 0, embers: 0` assertions and add `expect(wasmBindings.runScore).not.toHaveBeenCalled()` and `expect(wasmBindings.runEmbers).not.toHaveBeenCalled()`, proving the unfoldable path never scores. Copy the `expect(...).not.toHaveBeenCalled()` pattern already used for `runFold` in the same tests.
5. Run the checks in Tests and Done when. If `cargo jackioh spec check` reports anything about `R3496000`, the reword broke a link or marker: restore the exact `[[R3496000]]` / `[[§15.8]]` spellings, do not weaken the check.

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.test.ts`: the strengthened `B20 abandon records a loss and clears the run` (asserts `score: 120, embers: 12`, i.e. abandon is scored and paid) and the two `R3496000` unfoldable tests (assert `score: 0, embers: 0` plus `runScore`/`runEmbers` not called). Existing tests already fail if `settleUnfoldable` ever scores; the new assertions fail if anyone "unifies" the two paths.
- Commands: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/dungeon/store.test.ts`, then `cargo jackioh spec check` and `cargo fmt --check`.

## Done when

- [ ] `spec/15-dungeon-run.md` §15.8 no longer says the uncarried run "ends the same way" as abandoning; it states lost with 0/0/0 for its own reason under `[[R3496000]]`, while abandoning stays scored/paid under §15.10.
- [ ] `spec/rulings/R3496000.md` no longer attributes 0/0/0 to "§15.8's abandon rule"; it presents it as the ruling's own nothing-to-fold decision.
- [ ] No new ruling note, no `spec/pending/3637.md`, no edits outside the Files table; no test skipped, ignored or weakened.
- [ ] Web test file, `cargo jackioh spec check` and `cargo fmt --check` all green.

## Risks

- A weaker-reader risk: treating "ends lost" as "settles identically" and changing `settleUnfoldable` to call `settle()`. Avoid by changing no file under `crates/` or `store.ts`; the new `not.toHaveBeenCalled` assertions guard it.
- `spec check` is link-sensitive: keep every `[[R...]]`/`[[§...]]` target spelled exactly; wording around them is free.
- Do not "fix" the already-correct `pending/3496.md` paragraph (it never mentioned the abandon rule) or hand-edit `11-rulings.md`/`INDEX.md` (daily fold owns them).

## Open questions

None. No person-only step: all files are bot-editable and no secret, dashboard or account is involved.

# Notes

## State

All edits done per plan: `spec/15-dungeon-run.md:230` split abandon (scored/paid under §15.10) from unfoldable (lost 0/0/0, ruling's own nothing-to-fold reason); `spec/rulings/R3496000.md:19-20` drops the "§15.8's abandon rule" attribution; `store.test.ts` strengthened (abandon asserts score 120/embers 12; both unfoldable tests assert runScore/runEmbers not called). No behavior change; no new ruling. Waiting on: web test run, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo fmt --check`.

## Log

- Confirmed `settle()` scores/pays vs `settleUnfoldable()` hardcodes 0/0/0: spec-only fix.
- Made the 3 file edits above.
- Started `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/dungeon/store.test.ts` and `cargo fmt --check`; both running.
- Web tests: 34/34 passed. `cargo fmt --check`: clean. `cargo jackioh spec check`: ok (1889 rulings, 4899 proofs, 61409 citations). `git status`: exactly the 3 intended files. Done.
